{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Midas|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Midas''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Looting]] III and [[Fortune]] I. It is crafted from an {{MCW|Ominous Bottle|ominous bottle}}, three {{MCW|Block of Gold|blocks of gold}} and four [[Estus Ash]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/looting_fortune.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Midas" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Midas is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Looting applies to swords, spears and shears in the pack. Fortune applies to mining tools, but its maximum level is I in Matcha Flavoured; higher Fortune comes only from [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tools. The ominous bottle is itself crafted with [[Benzene]].
